about: Owner ids from Mnemosyne hooks/owner.ts (ownerId), for Switch to copy as its golden fixture. input is the path asked about; root is the folder hashed (the parent of git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir inside a repo, else input as given); expected is the id. Checked by tests/bun/owner-cli.spec.ts.

rows.note: a folder inside a repo: the root is the parent of --git-common-dir
a linked worktree of /Users/a/dev/switch-agent: it shares the main worktree's owner (not --show-toplevel)
hashed per code point, first UTF-16 unit each; a per-unit loop gives another id
backslashes become forward slashes before hashing

/tmp/switch-link is a symlink to the repo /private/tmp/switch-real (macOS: /tmp is /private/tmp). git reports the root symlink-resolved and the CLI hashes it as reported, giving expected; a host that hashes the lexical root would get lexicalExpected instead. A path outside any repo is never canonicalised.
